title: Phylocanvas.gl
description: WebGL (deck.gl 8.8) tree renderer from the Centre for Genomic Pathogen Surveillance. It has no callbacks, so the demo wraps its methods (plugin/decorate) in our own React component and adds hit-testing, focus, columns, links and a scale bar on top.

applied: tip markers and tip labels in --fg1 (fillColour, fontColour as CSS colour strings, resolved in JS from the GBIF tokens by gbifTheme())
branches in --fg2 (strokeColour); width 1 to 3 px from a Library option (strokeWidth, one width for all edges)
highlight colour --color-primary: selection and highlight halo ring, the clade under the pointer (library recolours its edges and label), focus ring of the DOM rows (CSS variable)
label background --bg1 (backgroundColour, which must be an RGBA array, not a CSS string) and the canvas background --bg1 as the CSS background-color of our host element (not a library prop)

label font family from --font-body (Rubik): deck.gl builds a canvas glyph atlas from the family name, so the web font is awaited with document.fonts.load before the instance is created; size 10 to 16 px from a Library option

clade colours from the categorical palette (--purple-100, --periwinkle-100, ...) chosen by the shell: per-tip fillColour and strokeColour on every tip below the clade, plus styleNodeEdges so the clade branches take the colour
tip marker shape (circle, square, diamond, triangle, pentagram, hexagon, plus, cross; library Shapes) and size (fixed px) from Library options
dark theme: gbifDarkTheme() values pushed into the same props on a theme change (a setProps, no CSS)
runner tokens (background, foreground, branch, highlight, fontFamily) mapped onto host background, fontColour and fillColour, strokeColour, highlightColour, fontFamily
custom layers (ours): bar column in --periwinkle-100, column headers and scale bar in --fg2, text column in --fg1; library blocks mode uses a --green-100 opacity ramp and the categorical palette
customisation by hiding features: labels, scale bar, internal labels, branch-length labels, collapse to pie charts (all library props)
not_possible: CSS and CSS variables for anything drawn: it is a WebGL canvas, so tokens must be read in JS and re-pushed on a theme change; no inherited font, no prefers-color-scheme
italic or bold tip labels: deck.gl TextLayer takes a font family string only (scientific names cannot be set in italic; only an @font-face alias to an italic file would do it, not tried)
per-edge or per-internal-node colour and width: strokeWidth is global; an internal edge takes a colour only when all its children share it (styleNodeEdges); no internal node markers at all
hover colour different from the selection colour: one highlightColour drives the halo, the hovered clade edges and the hovered label
tooltip chrome: the library's own tooltip is the browser title attribute (setTooltip writes view.title); the demo uses the shell's tooltip fed by our hover events
marker size that follows row height: nodeSize is a fixed pixel size that also reserves layout space, so it is picked from the tree size

non-ASCII tip labels as shipped: the library's TextLayers use deck.gl's default ASCII glyph set (Ménétries is drawn as 'M n tries', CJK vanishes); fixed only by a page-wide patch of the TextLayer default characterSet to 'auto'
sharp rendering on high-DPI screens as shipped: the library hard-codes useDevicePixels false; deck.setProps({ useDevicePixels: true }) on the instance is a Library option
the library's own CGPS logo background on the host element: removed by DOM patching (style.backgroundImage = none), not an option
styling.notes: Colours and fonts go through props (CSS strings or RGBA arrays), never through CSS. The label background colour is the odd one: it is handed to deck.gl unconverted, so a CSS string draws black boxes. Edge colours only refresh when strokeColour changes identity (library memo bug), see docs/results/phylocanvas-gl.md. Built with deck.gl 8.8.27: 8.9.x (inside the peer range ^8.8.12) throws at load.
